GenAiPlugin.description: Applies a partial JSON config update to the GTM Configurator page. Pass only the fields that should change. Valid fields: company (text, max 120 chars), industry (must be one of the availableIndustries keys), accent (6-digit hex e.g. #FF5733), objectsCount (integer 0-999999), depsCount (integer 0-999999), healthScore (integer 0-100), note (text, max 500 chars). The update is routed via the sessionToken to the correct panel instance.
GenAiPlugin.genAiPluginInstructions: Call this action to update one or more fields on the GTM Configurator page. Always pass the sessionToken from the session variables — it routes the update to the correct panel. Build updatesJson as a JSON object containing only the fields you want to change. If the industry the rep describes does not exactly match an availableIndustries key, call GetGTMConfiguratorState first to get the list, then pick the closest match. After a successful update, confirm which fields were changed and their new values. If success is false, surface the errorMessage to the rep and ask them to clarify.
